{{Short description|Sports statistics}}
The first '''[[List of world records in athletics|world record]]''' in the '''women's [[long jump]]''' was recognised by the Fédération Sportive Féminine Internationale (FSFI) in 1922. The FSFI was absorbed by the [[International Association of Athletics Federations]] in 1936.

==Record progression==
===Indoor===
An asterisk indicates a record was repeated. All records since Drechsler's 7.32 m in 1987 were ratified by the [[IAAF]].<ref>{{cite web|url= http://trackfield.brinkster.net/RecProg_All.asp?RecCode=WI&EventCode=WF3&Gender=W&P=R |title= Main > Records Progression - World Indoor Records Women, Long Jump |website=trackfield.brinkster.net}}</ref>
